profile.headline: Temporarily located in the Dominican Republic | Senior Software Engineer | Azure Certified | .NET | Angular | React | TypeScript
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer, I build SPA and robust backends for various clients using Angular/React and .NET Core technologies. I have more than 5 years of experience in software development, and I am certified in Scrum by CertiProf.

At my previous role at Neural Technology Solutions, I contributed to the development of a machine learning platform that enabled data scientists to create and deploy AI models. I used Azure Functions to implement serverless microservices and Angular CLI to automate the frontend development process. I also worked with Motor Crédito, where I developed and secured multiple CRUD modules and a core screen for credit officers using Redux and Fluent Validation.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Significantly enhanced system performance for a key IOT provider, GeoTab, by expertly refactoring and upgrading two main functions. Achieved a drastic reduction in data latency, from a minimum of 2 minutes and a maximum of 10 minutes to an impressive minimum of 5 seconds and a maximum of 2 minutes, optimizing operational efficiency and data processing speed.

- Implemented a strategic data management initiative, leading to over $100,000 in storage cost savings by purging redundant data over 2 years old, aligning with best practices in data storage and financial efficiency

- Enhanced Cosmos DB storage and performance by implementing Time-to-Live (TTL) settings. This strategic change led to improved data management and system efficiency.

- Dramatically optimized Signal R latency from over 10 minutes to just 5 seconds. Achieved this by identifying and eliminating redundant Redis calls causing an N+1 issue and consolidating them into a single, efficient call, significantly enhancing system responsiveness

- Continuous Integration/Deployment Pipeline Integration, pull requests, code reviews, unit/integration/e2e testing.

Automated data optimization and cleansing processes in multi-tenant Cosmos DB and MSSQL databases using Python scripts, significantly reducing task completion time from 2 hours to just 1 minute.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure · C# · Azure Functions · Internet of Things (IoT) · .NET Core · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Implemented a comprehensive tool integration strategy using Azure Data Factory, significantly enhancing data integration processes across various environments, including UAT and testing

- Optimized the application by virtualizing its most frequently used pre-filter component, significantly enhancing the performance of specific modules.

- Steered the development of the Forecast Process, meticulously analyzing and segmenting complex challenges into smaller, manageable tasks. Leveraged my expertise to mentor and guide newer developers in executing these tasks, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery.

- Conducted thorough code reviews and created numerous unit tests to ensure the quality and accuracy of the tax calculation module
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure · C# · .net · Microsoft SQL Server · GraphQL · .NET Core

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Implemented a robust route security and authorization controls in the backend, ensuring data privacy and controlled access to application features.

- Successfully designed and implemented role-based access controls on the frontend, allowing for tailored user experiences based on roles and permissions.

- Implemented and configured Redux for efficient state management, creating a centralized data management system for critical requests.

- Engineered and delivered multiple CRUD operations for key entities, including cities, countries, and vehicles, streamlining data management and accessibility.

- Pioneered the development of a core data entry screen for credit officers, enabling seamless data input and empowering request state transitions.

- Continuous Integration/Deployment Pipeline Integration, pull requests, code reviews, unit/integration/e2e testing.

company.name: Motor Crédito, S. A., Banco de Ahorro & Crédito

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Client Collaboration and User Interface Enhancement:

Collaborated closely with clients to gather feedback and swiftly implemented modifications to the Register Visitor Screen, resulting in an improved and user-friendly interface.

Wireframes and Mockups Design:

Demonstrated design expertise by creating wireframes and mockups of the application, visualizing user experiences and facilitating effective communication between stakeholders and development teams.

API Integration for Seamless User Data Retrieval:

Successfully integrated the system with the Dominican Republic Id's API, automating the retrieval of user information, streamlining data entry, and enhancing user efficiency.
